+verify sequence it replaces: QK norm with the FP8 Q/KV store, TRT-LLM-gen paged
+decode with q_len_per_req=T, then norm + gate. Single GPU."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import functools
+import inspect
+
+import flashinfer
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.muse_spark_qk_norm_rope_store import FusedQKNorm
+from sglang.kernels.ops.layernorm.muse_spark_norm_gate_jit import rms_norm_gate
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+try:
+    import helion
+except ModuleNotFoundError as error:
+    if error.name != "helion":
+        raise
+    HELION_MEGAKERNELS = False
+else:
+    HELION_MEGAKERNELS = (
+        "cross_loop_pipeline" in inspect.signature(helion.Config).parameters
+    )
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.muse_spark_helion.attention_verify_megakernel import (
+        BMM1_SCALE,
+        EPS,
+        HEAD_DIM,
+        KV_WIDTH,
+        NUM_KV_HEADS,
+        NUM_Q_HEADS,
+        PAGE_SIZE,
+        Q_WIDTH,
+        QKV_WIDTH,
+        MuseAttentionVerifyMegakernel,
+    )
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=300, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="4-gpu-b200")
+
+pytestmark = [
+    pytest.mark.skipif(
+        not HELION_MEGAKERNELS, reason="requires Helion with cross-loop pipelining"
+    ),
+    pytest.mark.skipif(
+        not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] != 10,
+        reason="the megakernels are specialized for SM10x",
+    ),
+]
+
+MAX_CONTEXT = 1 << 20
+ROPE_CAPACITY = 32768
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _megakernel(
+    tokens: int, sliding_window: bool, bmm1_scale: float, eps: float
+) -> MuseAttentionVerifyMegakernel:
+    return MuseAttentionVerifyMegakernel(
+        torch.device("cuda"),
+        tokens=tokens,
+        sliding_window=sliding_window,
+        bmm1_scale=bmm1_scale,
+        eps=eps,
+    )
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _qk_norm(eps: float) -> FusedQKNorm:
+    return FusedQKNorm(
+        head_dim=HEAD_DIM,
+        num_q_heads=NUM_Q_HEADS,
+        num_kv_heads=NUM_KV_HEADS,
+        eps=eps,
+    )
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _flashinfer_buffers(tokens: int) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    sms = torch.cuda.get_device_properties("cuda").multi_processor_count
+    nbytes = flashinfer.utils.get_trtllm_gen_multi_ctas_kv_counter_bytes(
+        tokens, NUM_Q_HEADS, sms
+    )
+    counters = torch.zeros(nbytes, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    workspace = torch.empty(128 << 20, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    return counters, workspace
+
+
+def _rope_cache() -> torch.Tensor:
+    exponent = torch.arange(0, HEAD_DIM, 2, dtype=torch.float64) / HEAD_DIM
+    freqs = torch.outer(
+        torch.arange(ROPE_CAPACITY, dtype=torch.float64), 1.0 / (10000.0**exponent)
+    )
+    return torch.cat([freqs.cos(), freqs.sin()], dim=-1).float().cuda()
+
+
+def _make_case(
+    tokens: int,
+    sliding_window: bool,
+    seq_len: int,
+    seed: int,
+    padded: tuple[int, ...] = (),
+) -> dict:
+    """One verify step at KV length seq_len; the T new tokens are the last.
+    Tokens in padded get cache_loc 0 (the CUDA-graph padding slot)."""
+
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    pages = (seq_len + PAGE_SIZE - 1) // PAGE_SIZE
+    pool_pages = pages + 16
+    k_raw = torch.randn(pool_pages * PAGE_SIZE, KV_WIDTH, generator=g, device="cuda")
+    rows = k_raw.view(-1, HEAD_DIM)
+    k_norm = rows * torch.rsqrt(rows.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-5)
+    v_raw = torch.randn(pool_pages * PAGE_SIZE, KV_WIDTH, generator=g, device="cuda")
+    block_tables = torch.zeros(
+        1, MAX_CONTEXT // PAGE_SIZE, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"
+    )
+    # Page 0 holds slot 0, the padding sentinel: requests never own it.
+    perm = torch.randperm(pool_pages - 1, generator=g, device="cuda")[:pages] + 1
+    block_tables[0, :pages] = perm.to(torch.int32)
+    positions = torch.arange(seq_len - tokens, seq_len, device="cuda")
+    cache_loc = block_tables[0, positions // PAGE_SIZE].long() * PAGE_SIZE
+    cache_loc = cache_loc + positions % PAGE_SIZE
+    cache_loc[list(padded)] = 0
+    return {
+        "sliding_window": sliding_window,
+        "seq_len": seq_len,
+        # Unit-scale QKV projections: the gate spans both sigmoid tails.
+        "qkv": torch.randn(tokens, QKV_WIDTH, generator=g, device="cuda").bfloat16(),
+        "positions": positions,
+        "cos_sin_cache": _rope_cache(),
+        "k_cache": k_norm.bfloat16()
+        .to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+        .view(pool_pages, PAGE_SIZE * KV_WIDTH),
+        "v_cache": (v_raw * 0.25)
+        .bfloat16()
+        .to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+        .view(pool_pages, PAGE_SIZE * KV_WIDTH),
+        "cache_loc": cache_loc,
+        "block_tables": block_tables,
+        "seq_lens": torch.tensor([seq_len], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+    }
+
+
+def _clone(case: dict) -> dict:
+    return {k: v.clone() if torch.is_tensor(v) else v for k, v in case.items()}
+
+
+def _with_page_metadata_tail(cache: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Copy page rows into storage with an untouched qparam-sized tail."""
+
+    pages, page_data = cache.shape
+    qparam_tail = PAGE_SIZE * NUM_KV_HEADS * torch.int32.itemsize
+    page_stride = page_data + qparam_tail
+    storage = torch.empty(pages * page_stride, dtype=cache.dtype, device=cache.device)
+    storage.view(torch.uint8).fill_(0xA5)
+    view = torch.as_strided(storage, cache.shape, (page_stride, 1))
+    view.copy_(cache)
+    tails = storage.view(torch.uint8).view(pages, page_stride)[:, page_data:]
+    return view, tails
+
+
+def _paged_hnd(cache: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return cache.view(-1, PAGE_SIZE, NUM_KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
+
+
+def _run_megakernel(case: dict, bmm1_scale: float, eps: float) -> torch.Tensor:
+    tokens = case["qkv"].shape[0]
+    return _megakernel(tokens, case["sliding_window"], bmm1_scale, eps)(
+        case["qkv"],
+        case["positions"],
+        case["cos_sin_cache"],
+        case["k_cache"],
+        case["v_cache"],
+        case["cache_loc"],
+        case["block_tables"],
+        case["seq_lens"],
+    )
+
+
+def _stock(
+    case: dict, bmm1_scale: float, eps: float
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """(gated output, FP8 Q) of the served verify path."""
+
+    qkv, rope = case["qkv"], case["sliding_window"]
+    tokens = qkv.shape[0]
+    q_fp8, _ = _qk_norm(eps)._forward_triton(
+        qkv,
+        case["positions"] if rope else None,
+        case["cos_sin_cache"] if rope else None,
+        (
+            case["k_cache"].view(-1, KV_WIDTH),
+            case["v_cache"].view(-1, KV_WIDTH),
+            case["cache_loc"],
+        ),
+    )
+    counters, workspace = _flashinfer_buffers(tokens)
+    attn = flashinfer.decode.trtllm_batch_decode_with_kv_cache(
+        query=q_fp8.view(tokens, NUM_Q_HEADS, HEAD_DIM),
+        kv_cache=(_paged_hnd(case["k_cache"]), _paged_hnd(case["v_cache"])),
+        workspace_buffer=workspace,
+        block_tables=case["block_tables"],
+        seq_lens=case["seq_lens"],
+        max_seq_len=MAX_CONTEXT,
+        bmm1_scale=bmm1_scale,
+        bmm2_scale=1.0,
+        window_left=2047 if rope else -1,
+        out_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        backend="trtllm-gen",
+        q_len_per_req=tokens,
+        multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer=counters,
+    )
+    out = rms_norm_gate(
+        attn.view(tokens, Q_WIDTH), qkv[:, -Q_WIDTH:], None, head_dim=HEAD_DIM, eps=eps
+    )
+    return out, q_fp8
+
+
+def _fp64_reference(
+    case: dict, q_fp8: torch.Tensor, bmm1_scale: float, eps: float
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """FP64 causal attention over the post-store cache, then FP64 norm + gate."""
+
+    seq_len, tokens = case["seq_len"], case["qkv"].shape[0]
+    pages = case["block_tables"][0, : (seq_len + PAGE_SIZE - 1) // PAGE_SIZE].long()
+
+    def logical(cache: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        c = cache.view(-1, PAGE_SIZE, NUM_KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM).index_select(0, pages)
+        c = c.permute(2, 0, 1, 3).reshape(NUM_KV_HEADS, -1, HEAD_DIM)
+        return c[:, :seq_len].double()
+
+    key, value = logical(case["k_cache"]), logical(case["v_cache"])
+    q = q_fp8.view(tokens, NUM_Q_HEADS, HEAD_DIM).double()
+    kv_head = torch.arange(NUM_Q_HEADS, device=q.device) // (
+        NUM_Q_HEADS // NUM_KV_HEADS
+    )
+    scores = torch.einsum("thd,hkd->thk", q, key[kv_head]) * bmm1_scale
+    q_pos = torch.arange(seq_len - tokens, seq_len, device=q.device)[:, None]
+    back = q_pos - torch.arange(seq_len, device=q.device)[None, :]
+    visible = back >= 0
+    if case["sliding_window"]:
+        visible &= back <= 2047
+    scores = scores.masked_fill(~visible[:, None, :], float("-inf"))
+    attn = torch.einsum("thk,hkd->thd", torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1), value[kv_head])
+    attn = attn * torch.rsqrt(attn.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+    gate = case["qkv"][:, -Q_WIDTH:].double().reshape(tokens, NUM_Q_HEADS, HEAD_DIM)
+    return (attn * torch.sigmoid(gate)).reshape(tokens, Q_WIDTH)
+
+
+def _rrmse_cos(actual: torch.Tensor, expected: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[float, float]:
+    a, e = actual.double().reshape(-1), expected.double().reshape(-1)
+    rrmse = float((a - e).norm() / e.norm())
+    return rrmse, float(torch.dot(a, e) / (a.norm() * e.norm()))
+
+
+def _bytes_equal(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    return torch.equal(a.view(torch.uint8), b.view(torch.uint8))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "sliding_window,seq_len,padded",
+    [
+        (True, 300, ()),
+        (True, 2500, ()),
+        (True, 2100, (0, -1)),
+        # Long before short: no state may leak between launches.
+        (False, 2500, ()),
+        (False, 300, ()),
+        (False, 16, ()),
+        (False, 17920, (-1,)),
+    ],
+    ids=lambda v: (
+        ("swa" if v else "full")
+        if isinstance(v, bool)
+        else (f"pad{len(v)}" if isinstance(v, tuple) else f"len{v}")
+    ),
+)
+# The served scalars, then values far enough off that a baked-in constant fails.
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "bmm1_scale,eps", [(BMM1_SCALE, EPS), (0.5, 0.25)], ids=["served", "off"]
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tokens", [8, 16], ids=lambda t: f"t{t}")
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_attention_verify_matches_stock(
+    tokens: int,
+    sliding_window: bool,
+    seq_len: int,
+    padded: tuple[int, ...],
+    bmm1_scale: float,
+    eps: float,
+) -> None:
+    base = _make_case(tokens, sliding_window, seq_len, seed=seq_len, padded=padded)
+    stock_case, mk_case = _clone(base), _clone(base)
+    expected, q_fp8 = _stock(stock_case, bmm1_scale, eps)
+    actual = _run_megakernel(mk_case, bmm1_scale, eps)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+    assert _bytes_equal(stock_case["k_cache"], mk_case["k_cache"])
+    assert _bytes_equal(stock_case["v_cache"], mk_case["v_cache"])
+    assert torch.isfinite(actual.float()).all()
+    rrmse, cos = _rrmse_cos(actual, expected)
+    # An MK at least as close to FP64 as stock also passes.
+    exact = _fp64_reference(stock_case, q_fp8, bmm1_scale, eps)
+    rrmse_mk, cos_mk = _rrmse_cos(actual, exact)
+    rrmse_stock, cos_stock = _rrmse_cos(expected, exact)
+    max_abs = float((actual.double() - exact).abs().max())
+    assert (rrmse <= 1e-2 and cos >= 0.99995) or (
+        rrmse_mk <= rrmse_stock and cos_mk >= cos_stock
+    ), (
+        f"vs stock {rrmse:.3e}/{cos:.7f}, vs fp64 mk {rrmse_mk:.3e} "
+        f"stock {rrmse_stock:.3e}, max abs {max_abs:.3e}"
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("sliding_window", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tokens", [8, 16], ids=lambda t: f"t{t}")
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_attention_verify_supports_per_page_metadata_gaps(
+    tokens: int, sliding_window: bool
+) -> None:
+    base = _make_case(tokens, sliding_window, seq_len=300, seed=71)
+    contiguous = _clone(base)
+    strided = _clone(base)
+    strided["k_cache"], k_tails = _with_page_metadata_tail(base["k_cache"])
+    strided["v_cache"], v_tails = _with_page_metadata_tail(base["v_cache"])
+    k_tails_before = k_tails.clone()
+    v_tails_before = v_tails.clone()
+
+    expected = _run_megakernel(contiguous, BMM1_SCALE, EPS)
+    actual = _run_megakernel(strided, BMM1_SCALE, EPS)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    assert _bytes_equal(strided["k_cache"], contiguous["k_cache"])
+    assert _bytes_equal(strided["v_cache"], contiguous["v_cache"])
+    assert torch.equal(k_tails, k_tails_before)
+    assert torch.equal(v_tails, v_tails_before)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))

+"""The T-token TP4 verify logits megakernel: the vocab-parallel lm head, the logit
+scale and softcap and the gather of the shards, as close to FP64 as the stock
+path, replicated on every rank.
+
+Run with ``python <this file>``; it relaunches itself under torchrun on 4 GPUs.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import atexit
+import functools
+import inspect
+import os
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.kernels.utils import multigpu_pytest_main
+
+try:
+    import helion
+except ModuleNotFoundError as error:
+    if error.name != "helion":
+        raise
+    HELION_MEGAKERNELS = False
+else:
+    HELION_MEGAKERNELS = (
+        "cross_loop_pipeline" in inspect.signature(helion.Config).parameters
+    )
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.muse_spark_helion.lm_head_verify_megakernel import (
+        LogitScalars,
+        MuseLmHeadVerifyMegakernel,
+    )
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=120, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="4-gpu-b200")
+
+pytestmark = [
+    pytest.mark.skipif(
+        not HELION_MEGAKERNELS, reason="requires Helion with cross-loop pipelining"
+    ),
+    pytest.mark.skipif(
+        not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.cuda.get_device_capability() != (10, 0),
+        reason="the megakernel is specialized for SM100",
+    ),
+]
+
+# The served shard, which is not a whole number of G blocks.
+HIDDEN, VOCAB_SHARD = 8192, 50512
+SCALARS = LogitScalars(scale=0.75, cap=20.0) if HELION_MEGAKERNELS else None
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _init_group_once() -> dist.ProcessGroup:
+    local_rank = int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"])
+    torch.cuda.set_device(local_rank)
+    dist.init_process_group("nccl", device_id=torch.device("cuda", local_rank))
+    atexit.register(dist.destroy_process_group)
+    return dist.group.WORLD
+
+
+def _inputs(seed: int, rank: int, tokens: int) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    # Replicated hidden states, per-rank weights; logits reach the softcap knee.
+    x = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed * 16 + rank)
+    hidden = torch.randn(tokens, HIDDEN, device="cuda", generator=x).bfloat16()
+    weight = 0.15 * torch.randn(VOCAB_SHARD, HIDDEN, device="cuda", generator=g)
+    return hidden, weight.bfloat16()
+
+
+def _stock(hidden: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    logits = torch.mm(hidden, weight.T, out_dtype=torch.float32)
+    logits.mul_(SCALARS.scale)
+    shards = [torch.empty_like(logits) for _ in range(dist.get_world_size())]
+    dist.all_gather(shards, logits)
+    logits = torch.cat(shards, dim=-1)
+    return SCALARS.cap * torch.tanh(logits / SCALARS.cap)
+
+
+def _fp64_shard(hidden: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    logits = (hidden.double() @ weight.double().T) * SCALARS.scale
+    return SCALARS.cap * torch.tanh(logits / SCALARS.cap)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tokens", [8, 16], ids=lambda t: f"t{t}")
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_lm_head_verify_matches_stock_logits(tokens: int) -> None:
+    group = _init_group_once()
+    rank, world = group.rank(), group.size()
+    mk = MuseLmHeadVerifyMegakernel(
+        torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device()),
+        group,
+        SCALARS,
+        tokens=tokens,
+        vocab_shard=VOCAB_SHARD,
+    )
+    failures = []
+    # Fresh inputs per call, so a stale cross-launch shard block shows up.
+    for seed in range(21, 26):
+        hidden, weight = _inputs(seed, rank, tokens)
+        out = torch.full((tokens, world * VOCAB_SHARD), float("nan"), device="cuda")
+        logits = mk(hidden_states=hidden, weight=weight, out=out)
+        stock = _stock(hidden, weight)
+        ref = _fp64_shard(hidden, weight)
+        mine = logits.view(tokens, world, VOCAB_SHARD)[:, rank].double()
+        theirs = stock.view(tokens, world, VOCAB_SHARD)[:, rank].double()
+        err = (mine - ref).abs().max().item()
+        stock_err = (theirs - ref).abs().max().item()
+        peers = [torch.empty_like(logits) for _ in range(world)]
+        dist.all_gather(peers, logits)
+        replicated = all(torch.equal(p, logits) for p in peers)
+        if not (
+            logits.data_ptr() == out.data_ptr()
+            and replicated
+            and err <= 2 * stock_err + 1e-4
+        ):
+            failures.append(
+                f"seed {seed}: err {err:.3e} (stock {stock_err:.3e}) "
+                f"replicated {replicated}"
+            )
+    ok = torch.tensor([int(not failures)], device="cuda")
+    dist.all_reduce(ok, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN)
+    assert ok.item(), f"rank {rank}/{world}: {failures}"
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    multigpu_pytest_main(__name__, __file__, num_gpus=(4,))

+def _routes(kind: str, tokens: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """[T, 8] distinct experts per token. same8: all tokens route one set of 8;
+    shared: subsets of a 20-expert pool; uniform: any 8; disjoint: 128 distinct."""
+
+    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(ROUTE_SEEDS[kind])
+    order = torch.randperm(EXPERTS, generator=g)
+    if kind == "disjoint":
+        return order[: tokens * TOPK].view(tokens, TOPK)
+    pool = order[: {"same8": TOPK, "shared": 20, "uniform": EXPERTS}[kind]]
+    picks = [
+        pool[torch.randperm(pool.numel(), generator=g)[:TOPK]] for _ in range(tokens)
+    ]
+    return torch.stack(picks)
+
+
+def _random_experts(ids: list[int], seed: int) -> LogicalExperts:
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    n = len(ids)
+
+    def scales(*shape: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # E4M3 values in [2^-9, 2^-5): a spread of exponents, no zeros.
+        exponent = torch.randint(-9, -5, shape, device="cuda", generator=g)
+        mantissa = 1 + torch.rand(shape, device="cuda", generator=g)
+        return (mantissa * torch.exp2(exponent.float())).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+
+    def nibbles(*shape: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return torch.randint(
+            0, 256, shape, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda", generator=g
+        )
+
+    return LogicalExperts(
+        ids=ids,
+        w13=nibbles(n, 2 * INTERMEDIATE, HIDDEN // 2),
+        w13_scale=scales(n, 2 * INTERMEDIATE, HIDDEN // 16),
+        w13_scale_2=0.5 + torch.rand(n, 2, device="cuda", generator=g),
+        w2=nibbles(n, HIDDEN, INTERMEDIATE // 2),
+        w2_scale=scales(n, HIDDEN, INTERMEDIATE // 16),
+        w2_scale_2=0.5 + torch.rand(n, device="cuda", generator=g),
+    )
+
+
+def _rank_weights(logical: LogicalExperts, rank: int, world: int) -> RankWeights:
+    """Expert-TP narrow of the checkpoint tensors, then the served FI prep."""
+
+    local = INTERMEDIATE // world
+    gate = slice(rank * local, (rank + 1) * local)
+    up = slice(INTERMEDIATE + rank * local, INTERMEDIATE + (rank + 1) * local)
+    w13 = torch.cat((logical.w13[:, gate], logical.w13[:, up]), dim=1)
+    w13_scale = torch.cat((logical.w13_scale[:, gate], logical.w13_scale[:, up]), dim=1)
+    k2 = slice(rank * local // 2, (rank + 1) * local // 2)
+    w2 = logical.w2[:, :, k2].contiguous()
+    w2_scale = logical.w2_scale[:, :, rank * local // 16 : (rank + 1) * local // 16]
+    w13, w13_scale = reorder_w1w3_to_w3w1(w13, w13_scale)
+    w13, w13_scale, w2, w2_scale = prepare_static_weights_for_trtllm_fp4_moe(
+        w13,
+        w2,
+        w13_scale,
+        w2_scale.contiguous(),
+        HIDDEN,
+        local,
+        len(logical.ids),
+        is_gated=True,
+    )
+    ids = torch.tensor(logical.ids, device="cuda")
+
+    def scatter(values: torch.Tensor, *shape: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        full = torch.empty((EXPERTS, *shape), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+        full[ids] = values.view(torch.uint8).reshape(len(ids), *shape)
+        return full
+
+    e4m3 = torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    return RankWeights(
+        w13=scatter(w13, 2 * local, HIDDEN // 2),
+        w13_scale=scatter(w13_scale, 2 * local, HIDDEN // 16).view(e4m3),
+        w2=scatter(w2, HIDDEN, local // 2),
+        w2_scale=scatter(w2_scale, HIDDEN, local // 16).view(e4m3),
+    )
+
+
+def _kernel_alphas(
+    logical: LogicalExperts, fc2_scale: float
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """(up, gate, out) FP32 alphas; as served, the static FC2 input scale is
+    folded into up and out, so the kernel quantizes z with a unit global scale."""
+
+    ids = torch.tensor(logical.ids, device="cuda")
+    up, gate, out = (torch.ones(EXPERTS, device="cuda") for _ in range(3))
+    up[ids] = logical.w13_scale_2[:, 1] / fc2_scale
+    gate[ids] = logical.w13_scale_2[:, 0]
+    out[ids] = logical.w2_scale_2 * fc2_scale
+    return up, gate, out
+
+
+def _random_activation(seed: int, tokens: int) -> Activation:
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    exponent = torch.randint(-8, -4, (tokens, HIDDEN // 16), device="cuda", generator=g)
+    return Activation(
+        hidden_states=torch.randint(
+            0, 256, (tokens, HIDDEN // 2), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda", generator=g
+        ),
+        hidden_states_scale=torch.exp2(exponent.float()).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+        per_token_scale=0.5 + torch.rand(tokens, device="cuda", generator=g),
+    )
+
+
+def _pack_routes(topk_ids: torch.Tensor, seed: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """FlashInfer PackedScoreIdx words: expert id << 16 | BF16 route weight."""
+
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    raw = 0.25 + torch.rand(len(topk_ids), TOPK, device="cuda", generator=g)
+    scores = (raw / raw.sum(-1, keepdim=True)).bfloat16().view(torch.int16)
+    expert = topk_ids.to(torch.int32).cuda()
+    return (expert << 16) | (scores.to(torch.int32) & 0xFFFF)
+
+
+def _boundary(tokens: int) -> Boundary:
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(11)
+
+    def randn(*shape: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return torch.randn(*shape, device="cuda", generator=g)
+
+    return Boundary(
+        unpool=(randn(MODEL_HIDDEN, HIDDEN) / 64.0).bfloat16(),
+        stream=randn(tokens, MODEL_HIDDEN) * 4.0,
+        alpha=1.0 + 0.1 * randn(MODEL_HIDDEN),
+        beta=0.5 + 0.1 * randn(MODEL_HIDDEN),
+        post_weight=(1.0 + 0.1 * randn(MODEL_HIDDEN)).bfloat16(),
+        pre_weight=(1.0 + 0.1 * randn(MODEL_HIDDEN)).bfloat16(),
+        qkv=(randn(QKV_OUT, MODEL_HIDDEN) / 90.0).bfloat16(),
+    )
+
+
+def _dequant(packed: torch.Tensor, scale: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """FP64 values of NVFP4 bytes [..., K/2] (low nibble first), E4M3 [..., K/16]."""
+
+    lut = torch.tensor(E2M1 + tuple(-v for v in E2M1), dtype=torch.float64).cuda()
+    values = torch.stack((lut[(packed & 15).long()], lut[(packed >> 4).long()]), -1)
+    values = values.reshape(*packed.shape[:-1], packed.shape[-1] * 2)
+    return values * scale.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).double().repeat_interleave(16, -1)
+
+
+def _round_e2m1(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """e2m1 round-to-nearest-even, saturating at 6."""
+
+    a = x.abs()
+    index = sum(
+        (a >= b if odd_below else a > b).int()
+        for b, odd_below in (
+            (0.25, False),
+            (0.75, True),
+            (1.25, False),
+            (1.75, True),
+            (2.5, False),
+            (3.5, True),
+            (5.0, False),
+        )
+    )
+    return torch.tensor(E2M1, device=x.device)[index] * torch.sign(x)
+
+
+def _quant_unit(act: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """NVFP4 with a unit global scale (the FC2 input scale is pre-applied),
+    dequantized to FP64: the kernel's FC2 input."""
+
+    blocks = act.float().reshape(act.shape[0], -1, 16)
+    fp8 = (blocks.abs().amax(-1) / 6.0).clamp(max=448.0)
+    fp8 = fp8.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn).float()
+    x = blocks * torch.where(fp8 != 0, 1.0 / fp8, 0.0)[..., None]
+    return (_round_e2m1(x) * fp8[..., None]).reshape(act.shape).double()
+
+
+def _quant_full_row(act: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """FlashInfer's dynamic BF16 -> NVFP4 FC2 requant of full rows (the B=1
+    recipe), dequantized: (FP64 values [R, I], FP32 token scale [R])."""
+
+    act = act.clamp(-BF16_MAX, BF16_MAX).bfloat16()
+    blocks = act.float().reshape(act.shape[0], -1, 16)
+    block_amax = blocks.abs().amax(-1)
+    token_scale = block_amax.amax(-1, keepdim=True) * FC2_GLOBAL_SCALE_INV
+    encode = torch.where(token_scale != 0, 1.0 / token_scale, FP32_MAX)
+    fp8 = (encode * (block_amax * (1.0 / 6.0))).clamp(max=448.0)
+    fp8 = fp8.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn).float()
+    out_scale = torch.where(fp8 != 0, 1.0 / (fp8 * (1.0 / encode)), 0.0)
+    x = blocks * out_scale[..., None]
+    values = (_round_e2m1(x) * fp8[..., None]).reshape(act.shape).double()
+    return values, token_scale.view(-1)
+
+
+def _swiglu_rows(
+    logical: LogicalExperts, topk_ids: torch.Tensor, x: Activation
+) -> list[RoutedRows]:
+    """FP64 W13 GEMMs of each routed expert's tokens, then the FP32 SwiGLU with
+    the per-token scale and the unfolded W13 alphas."""
+
+    x_deq = _dequant(x.hidden_states, x.hidden_states_scale)
+    topk_ids = topk_ids.cuda()
+    out = []
+    for slot, expert in enumerate(logical.ids):
+        tokens, topk_slots = (topk_ids == expert).nonzero().unbind(-1)
+        if tokens.numel() == 0:
+            continue
+        w13 = _dequant(logical.w13[slot], logical.w13_scale[slot])
+        acc = (x_deq[tokens] @ w13.T).float().clamp(-FP32_MAX, FP32_MAX)
+        scale = x.per_token_scale[tokens][:, None] * logical.w13_scale_2[slot]
+        gate = acc[:, :INTERMEDIATE] * scale[:, 0:1]
+        up = acc[:, INTERMEDIATE:] * scale[:, 1:2]
+        act = gate / (1.0 + torch.exp(-gate)) * up
+        out.append(RoutedRows(slot=slot, tokens=tokens, topk_slots=topk_slots, act=act))
+    return out
+
+
+def _make_case(kinds: tuple[str, ...], group: dist.ProcessGroup, tokens: int) -> Case:
+    """Every draw's experts in one bank; the static FC2 input scale is calibrated
+    on the routed rows of all draws, as a checkpoint's input scale would be."""
+
+    topk = [_routes(kind, tokens) for kind in kinds]
+    ids = sorted(set().union(*(t.unique().tolist() for t in topk)))
+    logical = _random_experts(ids, seed=7)
+    weights = _rank_weights(logical, group.rank(), group.size())
+    bank = build_moe_tp4_verify_bank(
+        w13=weights.w13,
+        w13_scale=weights.w13_scale,
+        w2=weights.w2,
+        w2_scale=weights.w2_scale,
+        group=group,
+    )
+    del weights
+    draws = []
+    for i, (kind, topk_ids) in enumerate(zip(kinds, topk)):
+        x = _random_activation(100 + ROUTE_SEEDS[kind], tokens)
+        rows = _swiglu_rows(logical, topk_ids, x)
+        packed = _pack_routes(topk_ids, seed=5 + i)
+        draws.append(Draw(kind=kind, packed=packed, x=x, rows=rows))
+    amax = max(r.act.abs().max().item() for d in draws for r in d.rows)
+    fc2_scale = amax * FC2_GLOBAL_SCALE_INV
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(7)
+    norm_weight = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, device="cuda", generator=g)
+    return Case(
+        logical=logical,
+        bank=bank,
+        fc2_scale=fc2_scale,
+        alphas=_kernel_alphas(logical, fc2_scale),
+        norm_weight=norm_weight.bfloat16(),
+        draws=draws,
+    )
+
+
+def _gemm2_refs(case: Case, draw: Draw) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Routed W2 rows [T * 8, H] BF16 per FC2 input: the kernel's static recipe,
+    FlashInfer's full-row dynamic requant, and exact (no requant)."""
+
+    logical, fc2 = case.logical, case.fc2_scale
+    tokens = len(draw.packed)
+    shape = (tokens, TOPK, HIDDEN)
+    out = {
+        mode: torch.empty(shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+        for mode in ("static", "full_row", "exact")
+    }
+    for r in draw.rows:
+        w2 = _dequant(logical.w2[r.slot], logical.w2_scale[r.slot])
+        alpha = float(logical.w2_scale_2[r.slot])
+        full_row, token_scale = _quant_full_row(r.act)
+        inputs = {
+            "static": (_quant_unit(r.act / fc2), fc2),
+            "full_row": (full_row, token_scale.double()[:, None]),
+            "exact": (r.act.double(), 1.0),
+        }
+        for mode, (z, scale) in inputs.items():
+            g2 = ((z @ w2.T) * (scale * alpha)).clamp(-BF16_MAX, BF16_MAX)
+            out[mode][r.tokens, r.topk_slots] = g2.bfloat16()
+    return {mode: v.view(tokens * TOPK, HIDDEN) for mode, v in out.items()}
+
+
+def _finalize(
+    gemm2: torch.Tensor, packed: torch.Tensor, norm_weight: torch.Tensor
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Stock weight-first post-expert RMSNorm per route, then the weighted
+    route sum: [T, H] BF16."""
+
+    weights = (packed & 0xFFFF).to(torch.int16).view(torch.bfloat16).double()
+    rows = gemm2.view(len(packed), TOPK, HIDDEN).float() * norm_weight.float()
+    rows = rows.double()
+    rstd = torch.rsqrt(rows.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + NORM_EPS)
+    return (weights[..., None] * rows * rstd).sum(1).float().bfloat16()
+
+
+def _stock_tail(fin: torch.Tensor, b: Boundary) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Stock post-FFN per token: BF16 unpool GEMM, input-scale post norm, gate,
+    pre norm. Returns (new stream FP32, next attention input BF16)."""
+
+    branch = (fin.double() @ b.unpool.double().T).bfloat16()
+    v = (branch.float() * b.post_weight.float()).bfloat16().float()
+    normed = (v * torch.rsqrt(v.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + POST_EPS)).bfloat16()
+    stream = b.alpha * b.stream + b.beta * normed.float()
+    pre_rstd = torch.rsqrt(stream.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + PRE_EPS)
+    return stream, (stream * pre_rstd * b.pre_weight.float()).bfloat16()
+
+
+def _run(
+    case: Case, draw: Draw, b: Boundary, unpool: torch.Tensor
+) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    """One MoE launch on the input slot's first T rows and one tail launch on
+    its output, as served."""
+
+    tokens = len(draw.packed)
+    mk = _megakernel_once(tokens)
+    inputs = mk.inputs
+    inputs.fp4[:tokens] = draw.x.hidden_states
+    inputs.scales[:tokens] = draw.x.hidden_states_scale.view(torch.uint8)
+    inputs.per_token_scale[:tokens] = draw.x.per_token_scale
+    inputs.packed.copy_(draw.packed)
+    y = mk(
+        bank=case.bank,
+        packed_routing=inputs.packed,
+        hidden_states=inputs.fp4,
+        hidden_states_scale=inputs.scales,
+        per_token_scale=inputs.per_token_scale,
+        output1_scale_scalar=case.alphas[0],
+        output1_scale_gate_scalar=case.alphas[1],
+        output2_scale_scalar=case.alphas[2],
+        norm_weight=case.norm_weight,
+    )
+    gemm2 = mk.gemm2_ws.clone()
+    stream, attn, qkv = _tail_once(tokens)(
+        expert_output=y,
+        unpool_weight=unpool,
+        stream=b.stream,
+        alpha=b.alpha,
+        beta=b.beta,
+        post_weight=b.post_weight,
+        pre_weight=b.pre_weight,
+        next_qkv_weight=b.qkv,
+    )
+    return {"y": y, "gemm2": gemm2, "stream": stream, "attn": attn, "qkv": qkv}
+
+
+def _rrmse(got: torch.Tensor, expected: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    got, expected = got.double(), expected.double()
+    return ((got - expected).norm() / expected.norm().clamp_min(1e-30)).item()
+
+
+def _cosine(got: torch.Tensor, expected: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    return torch.nn.functional.cosine_similarity(
+        got.double().view(-1), expected.double().view(-1), dim=0
+    ).item()
+
+
+def _metrics(
+    case: Case, draw: Draw, out: dict[str, torch.Tensor], b: Boundary
+) -> dict[str, float]:
+    """Kernel vs reference errors; the tail is checked on the kernel's own y."""
+
+    rank, world = dist.get_rank(), dist.get_world_size()
+    refs = _gemm2_refs(case, draw)
+    fins = {m: _finalize(g, draw.packed, case.norm_weight) for m, g in refs.items()}
+    cols = slice(rank * HIDDEN // world, (rank + 1) * HIDDEN // world)
+    tail_stream, tail_attn = _stock_tail(out["y"], b)
+    _, e2e_attn = _stock_tail(fins["static"], b)
+    return {
+        "gemm2": _rrmse(out["gemm2"], refs["static"][:, cols]),
+        "y": _rrmse(out["y"], fins["static"]),
+        "y_cos": _cosine(out["y"], fins["static"]),
+        "y_vs_exact": _rrmse(out["y"], fins["exact"]),
+        "full_row_vs_exact": _rrmse(fins["full_row"], fins["exact"]),
+        "stream": _rrmse(out["stream"], tail_stream),
+        "attn": _rrmse(out["attn"], tail_attn),
+        "attn_cos": _cosine(out["attn"], tail_attn),
+        "attn_e2e": _rrmse(out["attn"], e2e_attn),
+        "qkv": _rrmse(out["qkv"], out["attn"].double() @ b.qkv.double().T),
+    }
+
+
+def _bits(t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return t.contiguous().view(torch.uint8)
+
+
+def _failures(
+    draw: Draw, m: dict[str, float], runs: list[dict[str, torch.Tensor]]
+) -> list[str]:
+    rank, world = dist.get_rank(), dist.get_world_size()
+    print(
+        f"[r{rank}] {draw.kind} " + " ".join(f"{k}={v:.3e}" for k, v in m.items()),
+        flush=True,
+    )
+    failures = []
+    close = m["gemm2"] < 1e-3 and m["y"] < 1e-3 and m["y_cos"] >= 0.99999
+    # The static recipe is also no farther from no-requant than the full-row one.
+    no_worse = m["y_vs_exact"] <= 1.05 * m["full_row_vs_exact"]
+    if not (close and no_worse):
+        failures.append(f"r{rank} {draw.kind}: MoE {m}")
+    if m["stream"] > 5e-4 or m["attn"] > 2e-3 or m["attn_cos"] < 0.99999:
+        failures.append(f"r{rank} {draw.kind}: tail {m}")
+    if m["qkv"] > 3e-3:
+        failures.append(f"r{rank} {draw.kind}: next-layer QKV {m}")
+    for key in ("y", "stream", "attn", "qkv"):
+        last = _bits(runs[-1][key])
+        if not all(torch.equal(_bits(run[key]), last) for run in runs):
+            failures.append(f"r{rank} {draw.kind}: {key} differs across calls")
+        peers = [torch.empty_like(last) for _ in range(world)]
+        dist.all_gather(peers, last)
+        if not all(torch.equal(p, peers[0]) for p in peers):
+            failures.append(f"r{rank} {draw.kind}: ranks disagree on {key}")
+    return failures
+
+
+def _assert_all_ranks_pass(failures: list[str]) -> None:
+    gathered = [None] * dist.get_world_size()
+    dist.all_gather_object(gathered, failures)
+    assert not any(gathered), gathered
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "kinds", [("uniform",), ("shared",), ("same8", "disjoint")], ids="-".join
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tokens", [8, 16], ids=lambda t: f"t{t}")
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_moe_tp4_verify_matches_full_expert_reference(
+    tokens: int, kinds: tuple[str, ...]
+) -> None:
+    group = _init_group_once()
+    rank, world = group.rank(), group.size()
+    case = _make_case(kinds, group, tokens)
+    b = _boundary(tokens)
+    rows = MODEL_HIDDEN // world
+    unpool = b.unpool[rank * rows : (rank + 1) * rows].contiguous()
+    runs = [[] for _ in case.draws]
+    # Repeat, and alternate draws, to cycle the cross-launch state.
+    for _ in range(REPEATS):
+        for i, draw in enumerate(case.draws):
+            runs[i].append(_run(case, draw, b, unpool))
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    failures = []
+    for draw, draw_runs in zip(case.draws, runs):
+        metrics = _metrics(case, draw, draw_runs[-1], b)
+        failures += _failures(draw, metrics, draw_runs)
+    _assert_all_ranks_pass(failures)
+
+
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_bank_aliases_w13() -> None:
+    group = _init_group_once()
+    local = INTERMEDIATE // group.size()
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(group.rank())
+
+    def noise(*shape: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return torch.randint(
+            0, 256, shape, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda", generator=g
+        )
+
+    e4m3 = torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    w13 = noise(EXPERTS, 2 * local, HIDDEN // 2)
+    w13_scale = noise(EXPERTS, 2 * local, HIDDEN // 16)
+    w2 = noise(EXPERTS, HIDDEN, local // 2)
+    w2_scale = noise(EXPERTS, HIDDEN, local // 16)
+    bank = build_moe_tp4_verify_bank(
+        w13=w13,
+        w13_scale=w13_scale.view(e4m3),
+        w2=w2,
+        w2_scale=w2_scale.view(e4m3),
+        group=group,
+    )
+    failures = []
+    # The stock FI W13 views alias the bank head, byte for byte.
+    head = bank.w13.data_ptr() == bank.weights2.data_ptr()
+    if not (head and torch.equal(bank.w13, w13)):
+        failures.append("bank.w13 does not alias the copied FI W13")
+    scale_head = bank.w13_scale.view(torch.uint8)
+    head = scale_head.data_ptr() == bank.scales.data_ptr()
+    if not (head and torch.equal(scale_head, w13_scale.view(-1))):
+        failures.append("bank.w13_scale does not alias the copied FI scales")
+    _assert_all_ranks_pass(failures)
+

+"""Streamed weight updates into Muse Spark BF16 experts after the TRT-LLM shuffle.
+
+On SM10x the experts are shuffled into the TRT-LLM BlockMajorK layout after the
+first load. An RL weight update then writes each expert again; writing it in the
+checkpoint layout crashed (``start (0) + length (128) exceeds dimension size``),
+and a permutation cache kept on the GPU was zeroed by a memory-saver pause/resume
+and scrambled the update.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.muse_spark.muse_spark_bf16_moe import (
+    MuseSpark1xBf16Experts,
+    _trtllm_bf16_moe_supported,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=60, stage="base-b", runner_config="4-gpu-b200")
+
+
+def _kernel_available() -> bool:
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        return False
+    return _trtllm_bf16_moe_supported(torch.device("cuda", 0))
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(
+    _kernel_available(), "needs SM10x and FlashInfer's TRT-LLM BF16 MoE"
+)
+class TestMuseSparkBf16ExpertsTrtllmUpdate(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_online_update_after_trtllm_shuffle(self):
+        """A streamed expert update after the first load must not crash and must
+        leave the shuffled weights equal to a cold load of the new weights."""
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        device = torch.device("cuda", 0)
+        num_experts, hidden, intermediate = 4, 512, 256
+
+        def build(gate_up, down):
+            experts = MuseSpark1xBf16Experts(
+                num_experts=2 * num_experts,
+                num_local_experts=num_experts,
+                local_expert_offset=num_experts,
+                expert_hidden_size=hidden,
+                intermediate_size=intermediate,
+                top_k=2,
+            ).to(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+            with torch.no_grad():
+                experts.gate_up_proj.copy_(gate_up)
+                experts.down_proj.copy_(down)
+            experts.prepare_trtllm_weights(None)
+            return experts
+
+        def randn(*shape):
+            return torch.randn(*shape, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+
+        gate_up = randn(num_experts, 2 * intermediate, hidden)
+        down = randn(num_experts, hidden, intermediate)
+        gate, up, new_down = (
+            randn(intermediate, hidden),
+            randn(intermediate, hidden),
+            randn(hidden, intermediate),
+        )
+        local_id, untouched_global_id = 1, 0
+
+        for shards in (("w1", "w2", "w3"), ("w1",)):
+            with self.subTest(shards=shards):
+                experts = build(gate_up, down)
+                expected_gate_up, expected_down = gate_up.clone(), down.clone()
+                for shard_id in shards:
+                    param, weight = {
+                        "w1": (experts.gate_up_proj, gate),
+                        "w2": (experts.down_proj, new_down),
+                        "w3": (experts.gate_up_proj, up),
+                    }[shard_id]
+                    experts.weight_loader(
+                        param,
+                        weight,
+                        f"experts.{shard_id}",
+                        shard_id=shard_id,
+                        expert_id=num_experts + local_id,
+                    )
+                    # Global experts outside this rank's slice are ignored.
+                    experts.weight_loader(
+                        param,
+                        weight,
+                        f"experts.{shard_id}",
+                        shard_id=shard_id,
+                        expert_id=untouched_global_id,
+                    )
+                    if shard_id == "w2":
+                        expected_down[local_id] = new_down
+                    else:
+                        offset = 0 if shard_id == "w1" else intermediate
+                        expected_gate_up[local_id, offset : offset + intermediate] = (
+                            weight
+                        )
+
+                cold = build(expected_gate_up, expected_down)
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(experts.gate_up_proj, cold.gate_up_proj))
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(experts.down_proj, cold.down_proj))
+                # A colocated engine's memory-saver resume zeroes GPU memory allocated
+                # while loading weights, so the cached permutations must live on the host.
+                for indices in experts._trtllm_permute_cache.values():
+                    self.assertEqual(indices.device.type, "cpu")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""Muse Spark NVFP4 expert weight updates on the Marlin backend, on CPU.
+
+Miles streams experts one at a time under per-expert names; the engine must
+write them into its checkpoint-layout stacks on the owning EP rank only and
+re-derive the Marlin repack of exactly those experts in place. The Marlin
+weight repack is a CUDA kernel, so it is replaced by a byte-preserving stand-in;
+the scale permutation and global-scale encoding run for real.
+"""
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+import unittest
+from contextlib import ExitStack, contextmanager
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.utils import MoeRunnerBackend
+from sglang.srt.layers.muse_spark import muse_spark_expert_tp, muse_spark_fp4_moe
+from sglang.srt.layers.muse_spark.muse_spark_bf16_moe import MuseSpark1xBf16Experts
+from sglang.srt.layers.muse_spark.muse_spark_fp4_moe import MuseSpark1xFp4Experts
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization import marlin_utils_fp4, modelopt_quant
+from sglang.srt.models import muse_spark
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+NUM_EXPERTS, NUM_LOCAL, HIDDEN, INTER = 4, 2, 64, 64
+BF16_PREFIX = "model.language_model.layers.0.mlp.experts"
+NVFP4_PREFIX = "model.language_model.layers.1.mlp.experts"
+MARLIN_NAMES = (
+    "w13_weight",
+    "w2_weight",
+    "w13_weight_scale",
+    "w2_weight_scale",
+    "w13_weight_scale_2",
+    "w2_weight_scale_2",
+)
+
+
+def _fake_marlin_repack(weight, *, num_experts, size_n, size_k, perm):
+    """Byte-preserving, expert-local stand-in with the real Marlin output shape."""
+    packed = weight.reshape(num_experts, size_n, size_k // 2).view(torch.int32)
+    return packed.flip(-1).reshape(num_experts, size_k // 16, size_n * 2)
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def _marlin_on_cpu(repack=_fake_marlin_repack):
+    with ExitStack() as stack:
+        stack.enter_context(
+            patch.object(
+                muse_spark_fp4_moe,
+                "_resolve_moe_runner_backend",
+                return_value=MoeRunnerBackend.MARLIN,
+            )
+        )
+        stack.enter_context(
+            patch.object(
+                modelopt_quant,
+                "get_moe_runner_backend",
+                return_value=MoeRunnerBackend.MARLIN,
+            )
+        )
+        stack.enter_context(
+            patch.object(
+                marlin_utils_fp4,
+                "marlin_make_workspace",
+                return_value=torch.zeros(0, dtype=torch.int),
+            )
+        )
+        stack.enter_context(
+            patch.object(marlin_utils_fp4, "_repack_moe_fp4_weight_for_marlin", repack)
+        )
+        yield
+
+
+def _layer(experts: nn.Module) -> nn.Module:
+    layer = nn.Module()
+    layer.post_attention_residual_gate = nn.Identity()
+    layer.post_feedforward_residual_gate = nn.Identity()
+    layer.mlp = nn.Module()
+    layer.mlp.experts = experts
+    layer.self_attn = nn.Module()
+    layer.self_attn._fused_o_norm_gate = Mock()
+    layer._fused_attn_boundary = Mock()
+    layer._fused_ffn_boundary = None
+    layer.operator_dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    return layer
+
+
+# EP-only layout: the experts read the expert TP width at construction and load.
+_NO_EXPERT_TP = patch.object(
+    muse_spark_expert_tp, "get_parallel", return_value=SimpleNamespace(moe_tp_size=1)
+)
+
+
+def setUpModule():
+    _NO_EXPERT_TP.start()
+
+
+def tearDownModule():
+    _NO_EXPERT_TP.stop()
+
+
+def _make_model(ep_rank: int, *, keep_checkpoint_layout: bool = True):
+    """Layer 0 keeps BF16 experts (an excluded layer), layer 1 holds NVFP4 experts."""
+    with (
+        envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_MUSE_SPARK_NVFP4_WEIGHT_UPDATE.override(
+            keep_checkpoint_layout
+        ),
+        _marlin_on_cpu(),
+    ):
+        fp4 = MuseSpark1xFp4Experts(
+            num_experts=NUM_EXPERTS,
+            num_local_experts=NUM_LOCAL,
+            local_expert_offset=ep_rank * NUM_LOCAL,
+            hidden_size=HIDDEN,
+            intermediate_size=INTER,
+            top_k=2,
+            quant_config=SimpleNamespace(group_size=16, use_per_token_activation=False),
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        )
+    bf16 = MuseSpark1xBf16Experts(
+        num_experts=NUM_EXPERTS,
+        num_local_experts=NUM_LOCAL,
+        local_expert_offset=ep_rank * NUM_LOCAL,
+        expert_hidden_size=HIDDEN,
+        intermediate_size=INTER,
+        top_k=2,
+    ).to(dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    model = object.__new__(muse_spark.MuseSparkTextForCausalLM)
+    nn.Module.__init__(model)
+    model.config = SimpleNamespace(
+        num_local_experts=NUM_EXPERTS, tie_word_embeddings=False
+    )
+    model.int4_checkpoint = False
+    model.nvfp4_checkpoint = True
+    model.model = nn.Module()
+    model.model.language_model = nn.Module()
+    layers = nn.ModuleList([_layer(bf16), _layer(fp4)])
+    model.model.language_model.layers = layers
+    object.__setattr__(model.model, "layers", layers)
+    return model, bf16, fp4
+
+
+def _expert_tensors(seed: int) -> dict:
+    """Per-expert tensors in Miles' quantizer_nvfp4 output format."""
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    tensors = {}
+    for expert_id in range(NUM_EXPERTS):
+        for projection, rows, cols in (
+            ("gate_proj", INTER, HIDDEN),
+            ("up_proj", INTER, HIDDEN),
+            ("down_proj", HIDDEN, INTER),
+        ):
+            tensors[expert_id, projection] = {
+                "weight": torch.randint(
+                    0, 256, (rows, cols // 2), dtype=torch.uint8, generator=gen
+                ),
+                "weight_scale": (
+                    torch.rand(rows, cols // 16, generator=gen) * 4 + 0.25
+                ).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+                # a 0-dim decode scale, distinct for gate and up
+                "weight_scale_2": torch.rand((), generator=gen) * 0.01 + 0.001,
+            }
+    return tensors
+
+
+def _stacks(tensors: dict) -> dict:
+    """The same experts as the checkpoint's stacked tensors."""
+
+    def stack(projection, suffix):
+        return torch.stack([tensors[e, projection][suffix] for e in range(NUM_EXPERTS)])
+
+    return {
+        "gate_up_proj": torch.cat(
+            [stack("gate_proj", "weight"), stack("up_proj", "weight")], dim=1
+        ),
+        "gate_up_proj_weight_scale": torch.cat(
+            [stack("gate_proj", "weight_scale"), stack("up_proj", "weight_scale")],
+            dim=1,
+        ),
+        "gate_up_proj_weight_scale_2": torch.stack(
+            [stack("gate_proj", "weight_scale_2"), stack("up_proj", "weight_scale_2")],
+            dim=1,
+        ),
+        "gate_up_proj_input_scale": torch.ones(NUM_EXPERTS, 2),
+        "down_proj": stack("down_proj", "weight"),
+        "down_proj_weight_scale": stack("down_proj", "weight_scale"),
+        "down_proj_weight_scale_2": stack("down_proj", "weight_scale_2"),
+        "down_proj_input_scale": torch.ones(NUM_EXPERTS),
+    }
+
+
+def _per_expert_names(tensors: dict, expert_ids):
+    return [
+        (f"{NVFP4_PREFIX}.{expert_id}.{projection}.{suffix}", tensor)
+        for expert_id in expert_ids
+        for projection in ("gate_proj", "up_proj", "down_proj")
+        for suffix, tensor in tensors[expert_id, projection].items()
+    ]
+
+
+def _load_stacks(model, ep_rank: int, stacks: dict) -> None:
+    parallel = SimpleNamespace(moe_ep_rank=ep_rank, moe_ep_size=2)
+    with patch.object(muse_spark, "get_parallel", return_value=parallel):
+        model.load_weights(
+            [(f"{NVFP4_PREFIX}.{name}", tensor) for name, tensor in stacks.items()]
+        )
+
+
+def _bits(tensor: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return tensor.detach().view(torch.uint8) if tensor.element_size() == 1 else tensor
+
+
+def _assert_bitwise_equal(test, actual: torch.Tensor, expected: torch.Tensor, msg=""):
+    test.assertEqual(actual.shape, expected.shape, msg)
+    test.assertTrue(torch.equal(_bits(actual), _bits(expected)), msg)
+
+
+def _fresh_marlin(ep_rank: int, stacks: dict) -> dict:
+    """Marlin tensors of a model that loads ``stacks`` and prepares once."""
+    model, _, fp4 = _make_model(ep_rank)
+    _load_stacks(model, ep_rank, stacks)
+    with _marlin_on_cpu():
+        fp4.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(fp4)
+    return {name: getattr(fp4, name).detach().clone() for name in MARLIN_NAMES}
+
+
+class TestPerExpertNvfp4Loading(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_streamed_experts_fill_owning_rank_stacks(self):
+        tensors = _expert_tensors(seed=0)
+        stacks = _stacks(tensors)
+        for ep_rank in (0, 1):
+            with self.subTest(ep_rank=ep_rank):
+                model, _, fp4 = _make_model(ep_rank)
+                pointers = {name: p.data_ptr() for name, p in fp4.named_parameters()}
+                # one call per tensor, so gate and up global scales arrive apart
+                for name, tensor in _per_expert_names(tensors, (3, 0, 2, 1)):
+                    model.load_weights([(name, tensor)])
+                owned = slice(ep_rank * NUM_LOCAL, (ep_rank + 1) * NUM_LOCAL)
+                for name, expected in stacks.items():
+                    if name.endswith("_input_scale"):
+                        continue
+                    _assert_bitwise_equal(
+                        self, getattr(fp4, name), expected[owned], msg=name
+                    )
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    pointers,
+                    {name: p.data_ptr() for name, p in fp4.named_parameters()},
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(fp4.nvfp4_stale_experts, {0, 1})
+
+    def test_bf16_layer_of_nvfp4_checkpoint_takes_per_expert_names(self):
+        """The checkpoint's excluded layers keep BF16 experts; their streamed
+        per-expert names must load there instead of failing as unknown."""
+        gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+        gate_up = torch.randn(NUM_EXPERTS, 2 * INTER, HIDDEN, generator=gen)
+        down = torch.randn(NUM_EXPERTS, HIDDEN, INTER, generator=gen)
+        for ep_rank in (0, 1):
+            with self.subTest(ep_rank=ep_rank):
+                model, bf16, fp4 = _make_model(ep_rank)
+                for expert_id in range(NUM_EXPERTS):
+                    for projection, tensor in (
+                        ("gate_proj", gate_up[expert_id, :INTER]),
+                        ("up_proj", gate_up[expert_id, INTER:]),
+                        ("down_proj", down[expert_id]),
+                    ):
+                        model.load_weights(
+                            [
+                                (
+                                    f"{BF16_PREFIX}.{expert_id}.{projection}.weight",
+                                    tensor.to(torch.bfloat16),
+                                )
+                            ]
+                        )
+                owned = slice(ep_rank * NUM_LOCAL, (ep_rank + 1) * NUM_LOCAL)
+                _assert_bitwise_equal(
+                    self, bf16.gate_up_proj, gate_up[owned].to(torch.bfloat16)
+                )
+                _assert_bitwise_equal(
+                    self, bf16.down_proj, down[owned].to(torch.bfloat16)
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(fp4.nvfp4_stale_experts, set())
+
+        model, _, _ = _make_model(0)
+        for suffix, tensor in (
+            ("weight", torch.zeros(INTER, HIDDEN // 2, dtype=torch.uint8)),
+            ("weight_scale", torch.ones(INTER, HIDDEN // 16).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(suffix=suffix):
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "not an NVFP4 expert layer"):
+                    model.load_weights(
+                        [(f"{BF16_PREFIX}.0.gate_proj.{suffix}", tensor)]
+                    )
+
+    def test_wrong_dtype_or_shape_is_rejected_before_writing(self):
+        model, _, fp4 = _make_model(0)
+        fp4.gate_up_proj.data.fill_(7)
+        good = torch.zeros(INTER, HIDDEN // 2, dtype=torch.uint8)
+        for name, tensor in (
+            # raw scale bytes would be cast numerically
+            (f"{NVFP4_PREFIX}.0.gate_proj.weight_scale", good[:, :4]),
+            (f"{NVFP4_PREFIX}.0.up_proj.weight", good[:, :1]),
+            (f"{NVFP4_PREFIX}.0.up_proj.weight_scale_2", torch.ones(2)),

+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "mismatch"):

+        self.assertEqual(fp4.nvfp4_stale_experts, set())
+
+
+class TestMarlinRefresh(CustomTestCase):
+    def _prepared(self, ep_rank: int, stacks: dict):
+        model, _, fp4 = _make_model(ep_rank)
+        _load_stacks(model, ep_rank, stacks)
+        with _marlin_on_cpu():

+    def test_stacked_reload_rederives_every_expert_once(self):

+    """Create a stub model object for ParameterMapper.from_model()."""
+    return SimpleNamespace(**kwargs)
+
+
+def _deepseek_mutate(name):
+    if "mlp.shared_experts" in name:
+        return name.replace("mlp.shared_experts", f"mlp.experts.{_DEEPSEEK_N_ROUTED}")
+    return name
+
+
+def _deepseek_scale_remap(name):
+    for s in ["k_scale", "v_scale"]:
+        if s in name:
+            return name.replace(f"{s[0]}_proj", "attn_mqa")
+    return name
+
+
+def _glm4lite_mutate(name):
+    if "mlp.shared_experts" in name:
+        return name.replace("mlp.shared_experts", f"mlp.experts.{_GLM4LITE_N_ROUTED}")
+    return name
+
+
+_LLAMA_SCALE_PATTERNS = [
+    (".activation_scale", ".activation_scale", ".input_scale"),
+    (".weight_scale_inv", ".weight_scale_inv", ".weight_scale"),
+]
+
+
+def _llama_scale_remap(name):
+    for suffix, pattern, replacement in _LLAMA_SCALE_PATTERNS:
+        if name.endswith(suffix) and pattern in name:
+            return name.replace(pattern, replacement)
+    return name
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def qwen_mapper():
+    """Qwen2/Qwen3 (dense): QKV fusion, gate/up fusion, no experts."""
+    return ParameterMapper.from_model(
+        _make_model(
+            stacked_params_mapping=[
+                ("qkv_proj", "q_proj", "q"),
+                ("qkv_proj", "k_proj", "k"),
+                ("qkv_proj", "v_proj", "v"),
+                ("gate_up_proj", "gate_proj", 0),
+                ("gate_up_proj", "up_proj", 1),
+            ],
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def llama_mapper():
+    """Llama/GLM4 (dense): dot-prefixed stacked params, custom scale remap."""
+    return ParameterMapper.from_model(
+        _make_model(
+            stacked_params_mapping=[
+                (".qkv_proj", ".q_proj", "q"),
+                (".qkv_proj", ".k_proj", "k"),
+                (".qkv_proj", ".v_proj", "v"),
+                (".gate_up_proj", ".gate_proj", 0),
+                (".gate_up_proj", ".up_proj", 1),
+            ],
+            custom_scale_remap=_llama_scale_remap,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def qwen3moe_mapper():
+    """Qwen3-MoE: QKV fusion + experts, no shared expert fusion."""
+    return ParameterMapper.from_model(
+        _make_model(
+            stacked_params_mapping=[
+                ("qkv_proj", "q_proj", "q"),
+                ("qkv_proj", "k_proj", "k"),
+                ("qkv_proj", "v_proj", "v"),
+                ("gate_up_proj", "gate_proj", 0),
+                ("gate_up_proj", "up_proj", 1),
+            ],
+            expert_params_mapping=FusedMoE.make_expert_params_mapping(
+                ckpt_gate_proj_name="gate_proj",
+                ckpt_down_proj_name="down_proj",
+                ckpt_up_proj_name="up_proj",
+                num_experts=_QWEN3MOE_N,
+            ),
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def deepseek_mapper():
+    """DeepSeek V2/V3: MLA A-proj fusion, shared expert fusion, custom scale remap."""
+    return ParameterMapper.from_model(
+        _make_model(
+            stacked_params_mapping=[
+                ("gate_up_proj", "gate_proj", 0),
+                ("gate_up_proj", "up_proj", 1),
+                ("fused_qkv_a_proj_with_mqa", "q_a_proj", 0),
+                ("fused_qkv_a_proj_with_mqa", "kv_a_proj_with_mqa", 1),
+            ],
+            expert_params_mapping=FusedMoE.make_expert_params_mapping(
+                ckpt_gate_proj_name="gate_proj",
+                ckpt_down_proj_name="down_proj",
+                ckpt_up_proj_name="up_proj",
+                num_experts=_DEEPSEEK_N_LOCAL,
+            ),
+            mutate_weight_preload=_deepseek_mutate,
+            custom_scale_remap=_deepseek_scale_remap,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def glm4lite_mapper():
+    """GLM4-MoE-Lite (GLM-4.7): QKV fusion, MLA A-proj fusion, shared expert fusion, custom scale remap."""
+    return ParameterMapper.from_model(
+        _make_model(
+            stacked_params_mapping=[
+                ("qkv_proj", "q_proj", "q"),
+                ("qkv_proj", "k_proj", "k"),
+                ("qkv_proj", "v_proj", "v"),
+                ("gate_up_proj", "gate_proj", 0),
+                ("gate_up_proj", "up_proj", 1),
+                ("fused_qkv_a_proj_with_mqa", "q_a_proj", 0),
+                ("fused_qkv_a_proj_with_mqa", "kv_a_proj_with_mqa", 1),
+            ],
+            expert_params_mapping=FusedMoE.make_expert_params_mapping(
+                ckpt_gate_proj_name="gate_proj",
+                ckpt_down_proj_name="down_proj",
+                ckpt_up_proj_name="up_proj",
+                num_experts=_GLM4LITE_N_LOCAL,
+            ),
+            mutate_weight_preload=_glm4lite_mutate,
+            custom_scale_remap=_deepseek_scale_remap,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+
+def to_expect(name, shard=None, n=1, expert=None, n_exp=None):
+    """Shorthand for expected MappingResult fields."""
+    return (name, shard, n, expert, n_exp)
+
+
+def _assert(mapper, ckpt, expected):
+    r = mapper.map(ckpt)
+    name, shard, n, expert, n_exp = expected
+    assert (
+        r.sglang_name,
+        r.shard_id,
+        r.num_shards,
+        r.expert_id,
+        r.num_local_experts,
+    ) == (name, shard, n, expert, n_exp), f"map({ckpt!r}) = {r}"
+
+
+# ── Tests ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+# fmt: off
+_QWEN_CASES = [
+    # QKV fusion (Qwen2, Qwen3, GLM4-MoE)
+    ("layers.0.attn.q_proj.weight",     to_expect("layers.0.attn.qkv_proj.weight", "q", 3)),
+    ("layers.0.attn.k_proj.weight",     to_expect("layers.0.attn.qkv_proj.weight", "k", 3)),
+    ("layers.0.attn.v_proj.weight",     to_expect("layers.0.attn.qkv_proj.weight", "v", 3)),
+    # Gate/Up fusion
+    ("layers.0.mlp.gate_proj.weight",   to_expect("layers.0.mlp.gate_up_proj.weight", 0, 2)),
+    ("layers.0.mlp.up_proj.weight",     to_expect("layers.0.mlp.gate_up_proj.weight", 1, 2)),
+    # Pass-through
+    ("layers.0.mlp.down_proj.weight",   to_expect("layers.0.mlp.down_proj.weight")),
+    ("embed_tokens.weight",             to_expect("embed_tokens.weight")),
+    # Standard scale remap (no custom_scale_remap)
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.k_scale", to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.attn.k_scale")),
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.v_scale", to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.attn.v_scale")),
+]
+
+_LLAMA_CASES = [
+    # Dot-prefixed QKV fusion (Llama, GLM4)
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight", to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.qkv_proj.weight", "q", 3)),
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.k_proj.weight", to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.qkv_proj.weight", "k", 3)),
+    # Dot-prefixed gate/up
+    ("model.layers.0.mlp.gate_proj.weight",    to_expect("model.layers.0.mlp.gate_up_proj.weight", 0, 2)),
+    # Llama-specific scale remap + stacked (scales follow their weights)
+    ("model.layers.0.mlp.gate_proj.activation_scale", to_expect("model.layers.0.mlp.gate_up_proj.input_scale", 0, 2)),
+    ("model.layers.0.mlp.gate_proj.weight_scale_inv", to_expect("model.layers.0.mlp.gate_up_proj.weight_scale", 0, 2)),
+    # Pass-through
+    ("model.layers.0.mlp.down_proj.weight",    to_expect("model.layers.0.mlp.down_proj.weight")),
+]
+
+_QWEN3MOE_CASES = [
+    # QKV fusion
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight",          to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.qkv_proj.weight", "q", 3)),
+    # Expert mapping (no shared expert fusion)
+    ("model.layers.0.mlp.experts.0.gate_proj.weight",   to_expect("model.layers.0.mlp.experts.w13_weight", "w1", 2, 0, _QWEN3MOE_N)),
+    ("model.layers.0.mlp.experts.3.down_proj.weight",   to_expect("model.layers.0.mlp.experts.w2_weight", "w2", 1, 3, _QWEN3MOE_N)),
+    # shared_experts falls through to stacked mapping (no mutate_weight_preload)
+    ("model.layers.0.mlp.shared_experts.gate_proj.weight", to_expect("model.layers.0.mlp.shared_experts.gate_up_proj.weight", 0, 2)),
+]
+
+_DEEPSEEK_CASES = [
+    # MLA A-proj fusion
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.q_a_proj.weight",            to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.fused_qkv_a_proj_with_mqa.weight", 0, 2)),
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.kv_a_proj_with_mqa.weight",  to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.fused_qkv_a_proj_with_mqa.weight", 1, 2)),
+    # Shared expert fusion via mutate_weight_preload
+    ("model.layers.0.mlp.shared_experts.gate_proj.weight",   to_expect("model.layers.0.mlp.experts.w13_weight", "w1", 2, _DEEPSEEK_N_ROUTED, _DEEPSEEK_N_LOCAL)),
+    ("model.layers.0.mlp.shared_experts.down_proj.weight",   to_expect("model.layers.0.mlp.experts.w2_weight", "w2", 1, _DEEPSEEK_N_ROUTED, _DEEPSEEK_N_LOCAL)),
+    # Custom scale remap (k_proj/v_proj -> attn_mqa, NOT double-remapped)
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.k_proj.k_scale",             to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.attn_mqa.k_scale")),
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.v_proj.v_scale",             to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.attn_mqa.v_scale")),
+    # kv_b_proj pass-through (decomposed in post_load_weights)
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.kv_b_proj.weight",           to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.kv_b_proj.weight")),
+]
+
+_GLM4LITE_CASES = [
+    # QKV fusion (GLM-4.7 uses standard QKV unlike DeepSeek which uses MLA-only)
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight",              to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.qkv_proj.weight", "q", 3)),
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.k_proj.weight",              to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.qkv_proj.weight", "k", 3)),
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.v_proj.weight",              to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.qkv_proj.weight", "v", 3)),
+    # MLA A-proj fusion (GLM-4.7 also uses MLA with q_lora_rank)
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.q_a_proj.weight",            to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.fused_qkv_a_proj_with_mqa.weight", 0, 2)),
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.kv_a_proj_with_mqa.weight",  to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.fused_qkv_a_proj_with_mqa.weight", 1, 2)),
+    # Gate/Up fusion (non-expert layers)
+    ("model.layers.0.mlp.gate_proj.weight",                 to_expect("model.layers.0.mlp.gate_up_proj.weight", 0, 2)),
+    ("model.layers.0.mlp.up_proj.weight",                   to_expect("model.layers.0.mlp.gate_up_proj.weight", 1, 2)),
+    # Expert mapping
+    ("model.layers.0.mlp.experts.0.gate_proj.weight",       to_expect("model.layers.0.mlp.experts.w13_weight", "w1", 2, 0, _GLM4LITE_N_LOCAL)),
+    ("model.layers.0.mlp.experts.0.up_proj.weight",         to_expect("model.layers.0.mlp.experts.w13_weight", "w3", 2, 0, _GLM4LITE_N_LOCAL)),
+    ("model.layers.0.mlp.experts.3.down_proj.weight",       to_expect("model.layers.0.mlp.experts.w2_weight", "w2", 1, 3, _GLM4LITE_N_LOCAL)),
+    # Shared expert fusion via mutate_weight_preload
+    ("model.layers.0.mlp.shared_experts.gate_proj.weight",  to_expect("model.layers.0.mlp.experts.w13_weight", "w1", 2, _GLM4LITE_N_ROUTED, _GLM4LITE_N_LOCAL)),
+    ("model.layers.0.mlp.shared_experts.down_proj.weight",  to_expect("model.layers.0.mlp.experts.w2_weight", "w2", 1, _GLM4LITE_N_ROUTED, _GLM4LITE_N_LOCAL)),
+    # Custom scale remap (same as DeepSeek: k_proj/v_proj -> attn_mqa)
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.k_proj.k_scale",             to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.attn_mqa.k_scale")),
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.v_proj.v_scale",             to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.attn_mqa.v_scale")),
+    # Pass-through
+    ("model.layers.0.mlp.down_proj.weight",                 to_expect("model.layers.0.mlp.down_proj.weight")),
+    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.kv_b_proj.weight",           to_expect("model.layers.0.self_attn.kv_b_proj.weight")),
+]
+# fmt: on
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("ckpt,expected", _QWEN_CASES, ids=[c[0] for c in _QWEN_CASES])
+def test_qwen(qwen_mapper, ckpt, expected):
+    _assert(qwen_mapper, ckpt, expected)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "ckpt,expected", _LLAMA_CASES, ids=[c[0] for c in _LLAMA_CASES]
+)
+def test_llama(llama_mapper, ckpt, expected):
+    _assert(llama_mapper, ckpt, expected)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "ckpt,expected", _QWEN3MOE_CASES, ids=[c[0] for c in _QWEN3MOE_CASES]
+)
+def test_qwen3moe(qwen3moe_mapper, ckpt, expected):
+    _assert(qwen3moe_mapper, ckpt, expected)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "ckpt,expected", _DEEPSEEK_CASES, ids=[c[0] for c in _DEEPSEEK_CASES]
+)
+def test_deepseek(deepseek_mapper, ckpt, expected):
+    _assert(deepseek_mapper, ckpt, expected)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "ckpt,expected", _GLM4LITE_CASES, ids=[c[0] for c in _GLM4LITE_CASES]
+)
+def test_glm4lite(glm4lite_mapper, ckpt, expected):
+    _assert(glm4lite_mapper, ckpt, expected)
